records.title: First repair kind is a domain move done by rewriting compiled string constants
records.body: {"why": "no compiler or AI needed; keeps structure (REP-2); content check decides (REP-4)", "how": "Utf8 constants in .class files of the host JAR; APK input refused (dex string pools need re-sorting and re-signing)", "runner": "domain repairs run no new code paths beyond the extension itself, so they install through the source host; the Landlock runner is for code rebuilds"}

records.title: Repair runner requires Landlock ABI 6
records.body: {"why": "ABI 4/5 lack signal scoping; a sandboxed program could kill same-uid processes (verified by the audit)", "coverage": "TrueNAS 25.10 kernel 6.12 has ABI 6; GitHub runners ABI 8", "extra": "seccomp connect gate (port-only Landlock rules would allow other addresses on the proxy port) and signal gate"}
